recruit_text.greeting: Listen, really listen. You can hear the rock settling. This town's built on good stone.
recruit_text.adjustment:
He landed underground, which was the one thing that made sense.

The first stone that lifted itself into his hand frightened him badly. He's used to it now, mostly.
recruit_text.forward:
To find out whether Potosí crossed over too, and whether anyone is still underneath it. His whole shift was in the mine with him.

In the meantime he's teaching the Onyxhollow apprentices to timber a drift the way his father did, and they've stopped laughing at the method.

stages.stranger: I'm Ramiro, a primalist. I listen to the rock. If I tell you to stop and listen, stop. The mountain always talks before it moves.
stages.acquaintance: I'm from Potosí, in Bolivia, under the Cerro Rico, the silver mountain. My father and grandfather mined it, and so did I, twenty years, from nineteen. Twelve-hour shifts, a cooperative that never paid on time, and every Friday an offering to El Tío, the spirit of the mine. You don't forget him, compadre.
stages.companion: My wife is Rosario. She ran a juice stall in the market. We've got two girls, Maribel and Sonia. Maribel wanted to be a geologist, and I was saving so she'd study the mountain instead of dying in it. I was deep in a shift, and I came up somewhere underground that wasn't Potosí, with this lamp on my belt. My family were in the city above.
stages.friend: My whole shift was in the mine with me that day. Men I worked beside for twenty years. I was in a different drift, and I found my way out, and I don't know what happened to them. Now the Dark Iron have broken into old tunnels below Onyxhollow, timbered the way my father timbered, with a miners' shrine. I need to go down. Will you come?
stages.sworn: They didn't make it out. The tunnels crossed over sealed, and my shift died down there in the first weeks, waiting for a rescue that couldn't come. We brought them up one by one, with the Dark Iron, and buried them in good stone with an offering to El Tío. Their names are carved over the tunnel mouth. My family were in the city, and I still don't know where the city went. Tupananchiskama, compadres, until we meet again.

moments.prompt: In a cave, he suddenly holds up a hand and tells everyone to listen.

options.reply: Ya, you hear that? It's settling, not moving. We're all fine, and you've got good ears.
Compadre, when I say listen, you listen. That's how miners stay alive.

moments.prompt: He's asked you to come down into the old tunnels with him.

options.reply: Gracias, compadre, stay close, and listen when I say.

options.text: What do you expect to find?
options.reply: I expect to find my shift. I already know how they died, mostly. I need to bring them up.

lines.bored_warning: We dig the same hole again and again, compadre. Find me some new rock.
lines.leaving_good: The rock was kind to us, compadre. I'll be in the mining quarter at Onyxhollow, underground where I like it.
lines.leaving_bored: Nothing up here's worth listening to. I'm going back down to Onyxhollow.
lines.after_wipe: Okay, we didn't listen. Next time we stop and listen first.
lines.wipe_warning: The rock keeps winning in here, compadre. One more shift, then I want some days in the quarter.
lines.wipe_leave: That's the shift over. I'll be in Onyxhollow for a while, compadre.
lines.zone_warning: Too much open sky and too much danger out here, compadre. I don't like either, so let's go back.
lines.zone_leave: Too much sky and too much danger, compadre. I'll be in Onyxhollow, in the mining quarter.
lines.gear_refuse: No, compadre, that's mine. Work a few shifts with me first.
lines.gear_taken: Take it, pues. I mined twenty years with less.
lines.gear_short: The rock doesn't care that I'm missing a piece, compadre, but I do.
lines.gear_upgrade: That's good work, and I thank you for it, compadre.
lines.back: The mining quarter's quiet, compadre. Where do we dig?
lines.send_word: Ramiro has sent word from Onyxhollow. He's ready to come out again.
lines.walkout_talk: Compadre, I lost my head when I left. Sit down and I'll tell you why, slowly, and then you talk.
lines.neglect: Compadre, you came up for air! I wondered if you'd gone down a hole somewhere.
lines.asked_to_stay: Ya, one more, then the quarter.
lines.on_break: Ramiro is back in the mining quarter of Onyxhollow. Come back after you've done a few more jobs.
lines.mail_yes: Ya, compadre, I'll come up out of the ground. Wait for me in {town}.
lines.mail_later: Compadre, there's a seam I'm following and I won't leave it now. When it runs out, I'll come up.
lines.mail_see_me: Compadre, I'll tell you slowly, and I'll tell you to your face. Come down to the mining quarter at Onyxhollow.

dungeon_clear.text: Good stone in there, mostly. One ceiling I didn't like, but it held.

zone_arrive.text: Too much sky out here, compadre. I'll be happier under a roof of rock.

town_arrive.text: Every Friday we left an offering for El Tío in the mine. I keep wanting to leave something at the gate when we come into a new town.

close_call.text: You didn't listen. The ground warned you, compadre, it always does.
